open_points.subject: M02 Slot.purpose vs action "author a function contract"
open_points.text: M02: "`purpose`: plain words for the owner and the agent, fixed when the slot is created" and "created when an agent with the author right issues the first contract version under a new slot name — there is no separate create action."
open_points.question: When the first contract version creates a new slot, how is `purpose` provided (required in that same request, optional, or kernel-filled)?
options: The first contract-authoring request must include `purpose` for new slot names
`purpose` is optional and may be empty/default on creation
open_points.default_guess: Require `purpose` in the first contract-authoring request for a new slot name.

open_points.subject: M12 Flow.purpose vs action "compose and prove a flow"
open_points.text: M12: "`purpose` of a flow is fixed when the flow is created" and "the first flow version composed under a new name creates the flow — there is no separate create action."
open_points.question: When the first composed version creates a new flow, where does `purpose` come from and is it mandatory?
options: The compose request for a new flow name must include `purpose`
`purpose` may be omitted and stored as empty/default
open_points.default_guess: Require `purpose` when composing the first version for a new flow name.

open_points.subject: Flow activation of proven read-only versions (K-08 vs Primary actions vs M18)
open_points.text: K-08: "A read-only flow is activated by the kernel once proven"; Primary actions: "activate a flow | agent or owner asks; the kernel activates a proven read-only version at once"; M18 source: "The kernel, after proof and, for effectful versions, the owner."
open_points.question: Is a proven read-only flow version activated automatically at proof time, or only when the activate action is called?
options: Automatic immediately after proof succeeds (no explicit activate call needed)
Only via explicit activate action; for read-only, requester may be agent/owner but actor recorded as kernel
Both paths are allowed (auto plus explicit no-op/idempotent activation)
open_points.default_guess: Only explicit activate action creates FlowActivation; for read-only it succeeds immediately and records actor as kernel.
